***A SUPERB FOUR BEDROOM DETACHED, 1.5 ACRE PLOT, STUNNING LOCATION, CLOSE TO RATHCOOLE AND SAGGART VILLAGES, VERY SPACIOUS 2,000 SQ FT***

Byrne Malone Estate Agents are delighted to present "Crockaunadreenagh" to the market. This fabulous four bedroom detached home (that requires modernisation) is located in the most idyllic, quiet and picturesque of settings. Sitting on a magnificent plot of 1.5 acres and surrounded by beautiful countryside and woods this property offers huge potential to any buyer looking for a quiet country pad.
Saggart Village, Rathcoole Village, Saggart Woods, Slade Valley Golf Club and Luggwoods are all within walking distance. The N81, N7 and M50 are all just a short drive away.
The house itself offers bright and very spacious living accommodation of approximately 2,000 sq ft that comprises of a large sitting room/diner, a kitchen/breakfast room, four double bedrooms, a family bathroom, utility room, separate W.C. and a superb entrance hall.
The magnificent gardens and grounds surrounding the property (south-facing to the rear) are laid to grass with mature trees, plants and shrubs. There is driveway leading to the house from the main gates and twin garages.
Properties of this type and location rarely come to the market, to view please call us on 01 912 5500
